# ankra_proxmox_templates (Data Source)

The VM templates of a Proxmox VE node, for `template` on `ankra_proxmox_cluster`. The counterpart of `ankra cluster proxmox templates`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_proxmox_templates" "pve1" {
  credential_id = ankra_proxmox_credential.lab.id
  node          = "pve1"
}

output "templates" {
  value = data.ankra_proxmox_templates.pve1.templates[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential_id` (String) Credential to read the catalogue through.
- `node` (String) Proxmox VE node (host) name (`data.ankra_proxmox_hosts`).

### Read-Only

- `templates` (Attributes List) Templates of the node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--templates))

<a id="nestedatt--templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `templates`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Template name.
- `node` (String) Node holding the template.
- `vmid` (Number) VM id of the template.
